annotations.title: Add YouTube sources to a collection

description: Charged like `transcribe`. Expand the given YouTube URLs, charge for the new work and start an ingest job in an existing collection. Maps to POST /v1/collections/{collectionId}/sources. $0.10/min standard, $0.25/min whisper by default, 1-minute minimum per video. Videos already in the collection are free. Pass a `quote_id` from `quote` to be charged exactly that price. Poll `get_status` every 10–30 s until `status` is completed, partial or failed; `completed` means every accepted video is transcribed and indexed, so the collection is queryable. API key required (the key's `write` scope). Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.

collection_id.description: Collection to add the sources to.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 hint for transcription, e.g. en.

max_videos_per_channel.description: Newest-first cap applied to each channel or playlist (default 25).

quote_id.description: A `quote_id` from `quote`: charges exactly the quoted price (400 if unknown or expired).
